test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Many ______ tales evoke the memory of Akbar and Birbal.
solution:
The correct answer is '**popular**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**popular**'.
 
• It means **'made for the tastes and knowledge of ordinary people'.** (जनसाधारण की रुचि और ज्ञानसार के अनुकूल)
 
 
• *Example: The **popular** newspapers seem more interested in the scandal than news.*

 
 
 

**Correct Sentence:__** *Many **popular** tales evoke the memory of Akbar and Birbal.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning** of other words:

 
 
• **Populated**: inhabited. (किसी स्‍थान में आबादी होना; आबाद)
 
• **Populous**: having a large population; densely populated. (एक बड़ी आबादी वाले; घनी आबादी)
 
• **Populist**: relating to or characteristic of a political approach that strives to appeal to ordinary people who feel that their concerns are disregarded by established elite groups. (एक राजनीतिक दृष्टिकोण से संबंधित या विशेषता जो आम लोगों से अपील करने का प्रयास करती है जो महसूस करते हैं कि उनकी चिंताओं को स्थापित कुलीन समूहों द्वारा अवहेलना किया जाता है)
